description: The Settings window: the test notification and its permission, the code of the GitHub sign-in on the clipboard, the notification settings of the system, the home directory for the paths of Tools as `~` (`core:path`: `tildePath` of ToolsPage, the toast of Install Agent CLI), its own destroy after a close request (a JS listener of close-requested, `useSaveBeforeClose` of SettingsPage, closes the window by `destroy()`; without it Escape, ⌘W and the close button keep the window open)
